content: Footnote 36: the opening of the Mafāḥiṣ in Tehran, Majlis MS 10196 ff. 52a-56a was copied and added to between 1420-25 as part of the earliest and almost complete collection of Ibn Turka's works with some court correspondence; the Prologue says it was almost certainly by the hand of his friend Sharaf al-Dīn Yazdī.
